operations.title: Figueiredo to Benincasa: WP23b derivation backbone — Vandermonde/chi_b(s) unification
operations.body: WP23b (ledger 1952): the classification is now derived, not only censused. The universal frame: detC = tr C^3/3 with anti-palindromy forcing odd harmonics. Diagonal class: two-3-cycle determinant formula + bracket telescoping. Block21: detC = ±M(z-z^-1) chi_b(s) W, W = 1 or a Gram-norm difference by attachment. Block diagonalization shows Vandermonde = ±(lambda1-lambda2) chi_b(s), recovering WP21's D_sec^2 = disc_b chi_b(s)^2 — one mechanism, two frames. CP-trivial locus = bracket-vanishing from disjoint row supports. All chart-level; physical typing untouched.
